# Battle of Balkh (1602)

| result      = Uzbek victory
| combatant1        =  Safavid Iran
| combatant2        =  Khanate of Bukhara
| commander1  = Shah Abbas I
| commander2  = Baqi Muhammad Khan
| strength1   = 120,000 soldiers, 10,000 musketeers, 300 cannons
| strength2   = 80,000}}
Aftermath
The battle ended with the retreat of the Safavid forces. The defeat of Safavid Iran prevented the annexation of the southern provinces of the Khanate of Bukhara. The victory is considered a significant achievement for Baki Muhammad Khan in preserving the independence of Transoxiana.
